verdicts.reason: It uses the function the instruction names, patches `config_module.os.register_at_fork`/`getpid` the way the instruction says to look them up, relies only on proxy and provider attributes that already existed, and checks only the outcome: exported resources carry the new PID and no-op or suppressed providers cause no error.

It is an end-to-end check after a real fork that span, log and metric resources carry the child's PID; it only grabs OpenTelemetry's own locks to recreate the locks-held-at-fork case the instruction names, and never inspects Logfire internals.
